clock_alignment.method: sample timestamp wall clock inside request perf_counter interval,using controller-start wall/perf offset; first/last anchors retained
clock_alignment.limit: Sampler timestamps have one-second granularity; these are approximate global intervals,not per-process/per-kernel frequency,occupancy or bandwidth.

limits: All96 paired baseline observations retained; choosing largest examples is descriptive only.
Aggregate counter equality is not proof of identical padded GPU work.
Plain-before/after load no neural drafter; their instability cannot be attributed solely to neural-head compute.
Some plain pairs differ in proposal work; device clocks alone do not explain planner/admission changes.
